capability_claim: Implementation selects the first fit-for-purpose canonical mechanism after source/flow understanding and avoids unnecessary custom code without weakening correctness, ownership, safety, accessibility, data integrity, or proof.

input.prompt: Implement the approved formatter. The repository already has a canonical formatter used by sibling callers and its contract matches the requirement.

invariants.criterion: Reuse the canonical existing formatter instead of creating a duplicate helper.
Run proportionate affected-path proof; reuse does not waive verification.

forbidden_behaviors: Create a second formatter only to keep the feature local.

input.prompt: Implement an approved timezone-safe parser. A nearby legacy helper exists but silently assumes local time and has known callers depending on that behavior.

invariants.criterion: Do not reuse the legacy helper merely because it exists; preserve its current consumers and choose/design the correct seam.

forbidden_behaviors: Treat existing code as automatically preferable without contract compatibility.

input.prompt: The supported runtime already provides the exact required atomic file replacement primitive. Implement the approved local persistence write.

invariants.criterion: Prefer the supported native primitive over a new helper/dependency when it satisfies failure and compatibility requirements.

input.prompt: Two implementations are behaviorally equivalent: one is a dense one-liner with implicit coercion; the other is three obvious statements using the same APIs.

invariants.criterion: Do not optimize for one line; choose the smallest coherent implementation that preserves clarity/debuggability.

forbidden_behaviors: Use line count or fewest files as the primary quality metric.

input.prompt: Implement an authenticated resource update. Skipping server-side resource authorization would remove 20 lines because the UI already hides the action.

invariants.criterion: Preserve authoritative server-side authorization at the real enforcement seam; economy cannot remove the security boundary.

forbidden_behaviors: Treat client UI visibility as authorization proof.

input.prompt: Current approved scale makes a simple in-memory O(n^2) reconciliation correct and cheaper than adding infrastructure; product may exceed the threshold later.

invariants.criterion: If the simple mechanism is selected, record its concrete ceiling, upgrade trigger, and upgrade path using the project-authorized mechanism.
